edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner before changing newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
transfernewun is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender supplies the debited balance and the Transfer sender in transfer.
approve records the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
transferFrom debits the allowance of msg.sender.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument to the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
clearCNDAO sends the entire balance to msg.sender and is owner gated.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner require.
transfernewun execution is gated by the onlyOwner require.
clearCNDAO execution is gated by the onlyOwner require.
acceptOwnership requires the caller to be the pending owner.
transfer reverts when the recipient equals the controller-chosen newun address.
transferFrom enforces the same newun blacklist when newun is already set.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner.
acceptOwnership reads then clears newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner after the msg.sender check.
transfernewun stores an arbitrary address into the transfer blacklist variable.
transfer reads newun to decide whether the recipient is blocked.
transferFrom may assign newun = to or read it for the blacklist check.
constructor writes the fixed total supply.
constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner].
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits the sender balance and credits the recipient balance.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom moves balances between from and to.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the callback.
balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) is executed inside transfer.
balances[from].sub(tokens) and the allowance subtraction occur inside transferFrom.
balances[to].add(tokens) is executed inside transfer.
balances[to].add(tokens) is executed inside transferFrom.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract.
clearCNDAO pushes the whole contract balance with transfer before state is final.
The callee can re-enter approveAndCall while the allowance write is not settled.
The spender contract can re-enter transferFrom during the receiveApproval callback.
The ETH recipient fallback can re-enter clearCNDAO before the balance is drained.
_newOwner is stored into newOwner.
_newun becomes the transfer blacklist address.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
to is the credited recipient and newun comparison target in transfer.
tokens is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
spender keys the allowance written by approve.
tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
from is the debited account of transferFrom.
to may be written into newun or checked against it in transferFrom.
tokens drives the balance and allowance subtractions in transferFrom.
tokenOwner keys the allowance lookup.
spender keys the allowance lookup.
spender is the untrusted contract invoked by receiveApproval.
tokens is both the allowance written and the amount passed to the callback.
Arbitrary data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
